title: He Lost His Father on 9/11. 25 Years Later, He Is Part of a Lawsuit Against Saudi Arabia
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
_**Note from our Editor-in-Chief:** Friday marks 25 years since the horrific
attacks on September 11, 2001. This interview is part of **Zeteo 's **special
week-long coverage of 9/11 and its aftermath in America, across the Middle
East, and worldwide. - **Mehdi**_

[ Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

* * *

A quarter of a century after the tragic attacks on September 11, the families
of some victims are continuing a pursuit of justice on behalf of their loved
ones through a [civil lawsuit](https://www.propublica.org/article/saudi-
arabia-september-11-lawsuit-trial-qaida) against the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

In a '**Mehdi Unfiltered ' **interview, 9/11 Justice president Brett Eagleson,
whose father Bruce was tragically killed in the attacks on the Twin Towers 25
years ago, breaks down the latest on the lawsuit and why he believes all the
evidence that's been uncovered during litigation "**points a big fat finger at
Saudi Arabia**." (The Kingdom, of course, denies any role in the 2001
attacks.)

"**What we 've learned is that the U.S. government has engaged in a systematic
cover-up of Saudi Arabia's role since about two weeks after 9/11**," Eagleson
tells **Mehdi**.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Eagleson also discusses Trump's [cozy
relationship](https://www.cnn.com/2025/11/20/middleeast/jets-chips-clean-
slate-mbs-trump-saudi-intl) with MBS and his failure "**to try to get Saudi
Arabia to admit culpability** " for the attacks on September 11, as well as
what he calls the "**shameful** " and "**pathetic attempt** " to
[ban](https://www.amny.com/politics/menin-mamdani-9-11-ceremony-defends/) New
York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani from attending a commemoration ceremony at
Ground Zero.
